class.name: SuperpositionScene
class.brief_description: An allowlisted scene with a stable network prefab identifier.
class.description: One locally trusted scene in a [SuperpositionSpawner] allowlist. Assign a unique numeric [member prefab_id] and a [PackedScene] on every peer. Network messages identify this local resource by ID; they never request an arbitrary resource path. The spawner compares the complete scene schema fingerprint before exposing replicated instances.

members.member: Unique allowlist identifier from 1 to 65535. Matching peers must map it to the same trusted scene schema.
Locally loaded scene instantiated for this ID. Received network data cannot replace this resource or load another scene path.
